roadmap.name: Live roadmap
roadmap.what: Builds a page from your issues and pull requests that shows what is done, what is now and what is next.
roadmap.if_off: No roadmap page is built or updated. Nothing else changes.

hosted-roadmap.name: Hosted roadmap page
hosted-roadmap.what: Reserved for a roadmap page on the web that anyone with the link can open. Nothing uses it yet.
hosted-roadmap.if_off: Nothing changes, because no hosted page exists yet.

close-on-merge.name: Close issues on merge
close-on-merge.what: Closes the story issue a pull request names with Closes #N once it is merged, and asks every pull request to name one.
close-on-merge.if_off: Issues stay open after a merge and a pull request need not name one. You close them by hand.

lanes.name: Work lanes
lanes.what: Tells agents to keep up to three separate lines of work open at once, one per set of files.
lanes.if_off: Agents keep one line of work open at a time. Work is slower, never less safe.

modes.name: Manual, semi and auto modes
modes.what: Lets you choose how much agents may do: ask you for every merge, some, or none.
modes.if_off: The mode always reads manual: agents never merge on their own.

merge-gate.name: Agent merge gate
merge-gate.what: Lets a reviewer agent merge a pull request after every check is green and it is approved.
merge-gate.if_off: No agent merges anything. You merge every pull request by hand.

uat-on-main.name: Test on dev before main
uat-on-main.what: Asks for a checklist of real tests on the dev link before a change goes live.
uat-on-main.if_off: A change can go live without the checklist.

freeze.name: Release freeze
freeze.what: Lets you stop all merges to the live branch with one file, until you lift it.
freeze.if_off: You cannot freeze the live branch. Merges to it are never blocked for a freeze.

environments.name: Dev and live links
environments.what: Checks that the project writes down both its dev link and its live link, and keeps them apart.
environments.if_off: The project may run without a dev link written down.

team-block.name: Handoff block
team-block.what: Asks every pull request to end with a short note for the reviewer saying what is needed.
team-block.if_off: Pull requests need no reviewer note.

roles.name: Who builds, who reviews
roles.what: Checks that the account that writes a change is not the one that approves it.
roles.if_off: The same account may write and approve a change.

story.name: Story needs a who and a done
story.what: Checks that each story a pull request closes says who does it and when it is done.
story.if_off: A pull request may close a story that says neither.

disable-comments.name: No quiet switch-offs
disable-comments.what: Fails a pull request that adds a comment turning a check off, unless it names the decision that allows it.
disable-comments.if_off: A check may be turned off with a comment and nobody is asked.

frontend-design.name: Design first for screens
frontend-design.what: Asks that every change to a screen names the approved design it follows, and shows the real screen next to it.
frontend-design.if_off: Screen changes need no approved design.

design-tokens.name: No loose colours or fonts
design-tokens.what: Fails a web style line that adds a colour or font value directly, instead of using the shared design values.
design-tokens.if_off: Colours and fonts may be written straight into style files.

component-registry.name: Ready-made screen parts only
component-registry.what: Checks that screens are built from the shared library of screen parts, not drawn by hand.
component-registry.if_off: Screens may be hand-drawn instead of using the library.

rule-copies.name: One copy of each rule
rule-copies.what: Fails when two copies of the rules text drift apart.
rule-copies.if_off: Copies of the rules may differ and nobody is told.

commit-subjects.name: Short commit titles
commit-subjects.what: Fails a pull request that has a commit title longer than 72 characters, naming the commit.
commit-subjects.if_off: A long commit title is found only by people, if at all.

pre-commit.name: Checks before each commit
pre-commit.what: Runs quick checks on your computer before each commit, so mistakes are caught early.
pre-commit.if_off: No checks run before a commit. CI still catches them later.

adoption.name: Kit is really installed
adoption.what: Checks that the project carries the ShipQuick checks for real, at the version it says. This guards all the others.

gate.name: The final gate
gate.what: Collects every check into one pass or fail that a merge waits for. This guards all the others.
